Comment_glosser: Historically, 20 in Semitic was formed as 10 with a dual marker and the other decades as 3, 4 etc. with a plural marker (Brockelmann 1916: 119). However, the suffixes have been regularized leading to the synchronically confusing system where 20 vs. other decades seem to be formed with the same suffix but different operations. Here, the regularized suffix is that of the historic dual, but 20 has been remodeled based on 2 and no longer contains 10. I am not sure what 10′ is synchronically.
